answer:
Use `POST http://localhost:11434/api/embed`. Its `input` field takes either a single string or an array of strings for a batch.

The docs show the endpoint in a cURL example: "curl -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/embed \" [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md]. A single string is passed as `input`, as in the Python example that calls `ollama.embed(model='embeddinggemma', input='...')` [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md (lines 8-63)]. For batches, "Pass an array of strings to `input`." [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md (lines 65-114)]

The API reference also documents an older endpoint, `/api/embeddings`, which takes `prompt` instead of `input`: "curl http://localhost:11434/api/embeddings -d '{" [ollama/docs/api.md (lines 1826-1848)]. The provided context doesn't say whether it is deprecated, so I'd use `/api/embed` unless you have a reason to need the older one.
